claim: The three effect send bytes tap the type's own output after its Level and Pan, summed to one signal and scaled by the byte over 127, and the system reverb, chorus and delay return into that output; a part routed through the effect sends nothing of its own.

rows: 40 03 17 EFX SEND LEVEL TO REVERB, 00 - 7F, default 28
40 03 18 EFX SEND LEVEL TO CHORUS, 00 - 7F, default 00
40 03 19 EFX SEND LEVEL TO DELAY, 00 - 7F, default 00

era_priors.claim: One signal for three sends is cheapest held where the effect has finished with it, and a byte over its full scale is one multiply.
era_priors.why: A send is a multiply-accumulate on a signal the DSP already holds; a second tap before the Level, or live sends on a part already routed elsewhere, is a second set of accumulators for the same part.
era_priors.would_be_wrong_if: The Level at 0 left a return sounding, or the send byte's steps followed its square.

adds: Which signal the send bytes tap and how they scale it. The records give the decorrelated share of a handful of settings; that one path after the Level explains all of them, and that a model of that path with its gains fitted on 01 00 alone predicts every other type's send directories, is not in any of them.

alternatives.reading: The sends are taken before the type's Level, so the Level scales the effect's own output and not what reaches the system effects.
alternatives.ruled_out_by: With the Level at 0 and the reverb send at its power-on 40 the take reads -111.84 dB decorrelated, the silence floor; the reverb it would leave sounding reads -71.66 dB with the Level at 127, 40.18 dB higher, 95.7 times the record's floor.

alternatives.reading: A part routed through the effect keeps its own sends live from its dry signal, in parallel with the effect's.
alternatives.ruled_out_by: With every effect send at 0 the take reads -109.52 dB decorrelated, where the part's dry take reads -109.48; the part's own reverb at its reset send of 40 reads -73.51 dB with the effect switched out, 36.01 dB higher, 102.9 times the two records' floors together. On 25 of 65 types the send-0 take reads below what that reverb adds by itself; the rest carry decorrelated power of their own above it and do not separate.

separated_by.sensitivity_here: 0.35 dB, the two records' floor_incoherent_db in quadrature

alternatives.reading: The send byte scales the return's power rather than its amplitude.
alternatives.ruled_out_by: From the reverb send at 40 to 127 the decorrelated share rises 10.08 dB; amplitude predicts 10.03 and power 20.07, 22.3 times the two records' floors apart.

separated_by.sensitivity_here: 0.45 dB, the two records' floor_incoherent_db in quadrature

refuted_by: A take with the type's Level at 0 carrying a return above the silence floor; a take with every effect send at 0 carrying more decorrelated power than the part's dry take; or the return's share moving between two send bytes by other than 20 log10 of their ratio, beyond the records' floors.

rate_profile.what: At each rate, the capped lag difference with the fitted delay and depth and each take's phase on a twelfth-cycle grid.

fitted_on_01_00.how: Each free value fitted on the 01 00 directory of its own send byte at 127 alone, on the part's dry takes drawn through the 01 00 model the stage put first and then through this path. The reverb and delay gains minimise the residual of each drawn take subtracted from the unit's on channels 2 and 3; `doing_nothing_db` is the dry drawing without the path and `floor_db` the unit's own takes of the setting against each other. The chorus is fitted on readings taken alike of both sides -- the lag its return sits at in 100 ms windows, and the rise in the efx-return level from the send at 0 -- and its `model_db` is the stage's residual at the stage's own phases.
fitted_on_01_00.why_the_residual_stops_where_it_does: The dry takes were recorded in another session: the same drawing against the unit's take with every send at 0 leaves about -28.8 dB, which bounds the reverb and delay residuals from below whatever the path does. A chorus take does not repeat, since a note-on does not restart its modulator: the unit's own takes of it subtract to -1.27 dB, so no residual on the wave can tell a right chorus from none.

held_out.what: Every other type's send directories at 127, predicted from that type's own takes with every send at 0 through the path with the 01 00 values, and read the way the efx-return records read the unit.
held_out.reads: 40 03 17: 59 of 64 clear the record's floor on the decorrelated share and 60 on the level, median error 0.06 and 0.05 dB; 40 03 18: 52 of 64 clear the record's floor on the decorrelated share and 52 on the level, median error 0.15 and 0.15 dB; 40 03 19: 55 of 64 clear the record's floor on the decorrelated share and 59 on the level, median error 0.08 and 0.05 dB
